Friess Associates Llc decreased its stake in Cummins Inc. (CMI) by 15.25% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 88,983 shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $14.42M, down from 105,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Friess Associates Llc who had been investing in Cummins Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $22.00 billion market cap company.
